tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Role, positioning, background, work formats and contact. Canonical facts about the person.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Measured results of the AI outbound sales agent: emails sent, hours replaced, replies, price requests, and what the agent does not do.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Pass a company inquiry to Rinat. Delivered to his Telegram. Use when an agent acts on behalf of a company interested in working together.

tools.name: search_public_ai_pages
tools.description: Read-only, deterministic lookup of publicly available pages on rinatsultan.com. Results are website sources, not a generated answer.

tools.name: explore_manufacturing_pilots
tools.description: Interactive MCP App showing three preliminary industrial AI pilots, their input data, KPIs and human approval boundaries; no model calls or operational changes.

tools.name: get_agent_protocol_catalog
tools.description: Read 16 source-backed protocol explanations and the implementation status on rinatsultan.com. Opens a read-only MCP App in compatible hosts. No payments, external fetches or operational actions.

tools.name: simulate_production_plan
tools.description: Synthetic read-only single-line production scenario. Reconciles demand, FEFO-eligible stock, 50 kg batches, raw input and shift minutes; explains unmet demand. Not a real factory plan, forecast or authorization.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "simulate_production_plan" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
